title: Vanishing module cohomology on all opens implies acyclicity for module-valued sections
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and F an O_S-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose that H^p(V,F|V)=0 [pqf-def-cohomology, lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] for every open V and p>0. Then F is right acyclic [def-sp-acyclic] for the O_S(V)-module-valued sections functor on S.Modules, for every open V.

proof.text: For fixed V, take an injective resolution F→J• in S.Modules. Restriction to V is exact and preserves injectives; thus F|V→J•|V is an injective resolution in V.toScheme.Modules.

Derived evaluation at V is computed by J•(V). Module cohomology of the restricted F is computed by global sections of J•|V. Restricted sections equal the original sections on V, naturally in every term and differential. The canonical identification of rings O_V(V)≅O_S(V) transports these module complexes and their cohomology by a scalar equivalence.
Equivalences reflect zero objects. Apply the assumed vanishing with p=q+1, for every natural q. This is precisely rightAcyclic for sections on V. Quantify over V.

lean.statement:
theorem module_sections_acyclic_of_cohomology_vanishing (S : Scheme.{u}) (F : S.Modules)
    (hcoh : ∀ (V : S.Opens) (p : ℕ), 0 < p →
      IsZero ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology V.toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
        ((restrictFunctor V.ι).obj F))) :
    ∀ V : S.Opens,
      (SheafOfModules.forget.{u} S.ringCatSheaf ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} S.ringCatSheaf.obj (op V)).rightAcyclic F
